Job Title: GPU DevOps / Infrastructure Setup Engineer

**Location:** Chennai, India  
**Experience:** 3+ Years  
**Required GPU Experience:** 1–2+ Years of Hands-on Experience  
**Job Category:** DevOps / Infrastructure Engineering / AI Infrastructure

Job Overview

We are looking for an experienced GPU DevOps / Infrastructure Setup Engineer to build, configure, deploy, and maintain GPU-enabled infrastructure supporting AI/ML, Large Language Model (LLM), and High-Performance Computing (HPC) workloads.

The ideal candidate should have practical experience in GPU server configuration, Linux administration, NVIDIA GPU drivers, CUDA, containerization, infrastructure automation, and GPU workload deployment.

Experience with NVIDIA Base Command Manager (BCM), GPU cluster deployment, InfiniBand networking, and production LLM serving will be an added advantage.

Candidates must have hands-on experience with at least one real-world GPU infrastructure setup, GPU cluster deployment, or AI/LLM infrastructure project. They should be able to explain the hardware used, their individual responsibilities, deployment process, and technical challenges resolved.

Key Responsibilities

* Set up, configure, and maintain GPU-enabled servers, compute nodes, and AI infrastructure.
* Deploy and maintain on-premises GPU infrastructure and AI/HPC compute clusters.
* Perform end-to-end GPU cluster deployment, including provisioning, configuration, validation, and testing.
* Install, configure, and troubleshoot Linux operating systems, NVIDIA GPU drivers, CUDA Toolkit, and supporting libraries.
* Validate GPU hardware detection, driver functionality, CUDA compatibility, and GPU workload execution.
* Configure and manage GPU-enabled Docker containers and deploy GPU workloads using Kubernetes.
* Deploy and maintain LLM applications using vLLM, Ollama, Hugging Face Text Generation Inference (TGI), NVIDIA Triton, or similar frameworks.
* Automate infrastructure provisioning and configuration using Bash, Python, Ansible, Terraform, or equivalent tools.
* Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure and application deployments.
* Monitor GPU utilization, memory consumption, temperature, power usage, hardware health, and workload performance.
* Implement monitoring, logging, alerting, and health checks using Prometheus, Grafana, NVIDIA SMI, DCGM, or equivalent tools.
* Troubleshoot GPU memory errors, driver conflicts, CUDA initialization failures, container issues, networking problems, and workload failures.
* Optimize GPU utilization, inference latency, throughput, VRAM consumption, and infrastructure performance.
* Perform infrastructure maintenance, patching, upgrades, capacity planning, and resource scaling.
* Maintain technical documentation, deployment procedures, configuration guides, and troubleshooting records.
* Collaborate with AI/ML, development, platform, and infrastructure teams to support reliable production deployments.

Required Technical SkillsGPU Hardware and Infrastructure

* Hands-on experience configuring and maintaining GPU-enabled servers.
* Knowledge of GPU server architecture, PCIe, power requirements, cooling, and hardware compatibility.
* Experience with NVIDIA A100, H100, H200, L40S, RTX series, or equivalent GPU platforms.
* Ability to validate GPU hardware detection and troubleshoot hardware-related issues.

Linux Administration, NVIDIA Drivers, and CUDA

* Strong Linux administration and troubleshooting skills.
* Experience installing and configuring NVIDIA GPU drivers and CUDA Toolkit.
* Ability to validate GPU availability using nvidia-smi.
* Experience troubleshooting driver compatibility, CUDA initialization, and GPU workload execution issues.
* Experience running GPU workloads directly on bare-metal infrastructure is preferred.

AI Infrastructure and HPC

* Experience building, configuring, or maintaining GPU-enabled AI infrastructure.
* Understanding of compute nodes, cluster provisioning, and GPU cluster validation.
* Familiarity with NVIDIA Base Command Manager (BCM) is preferred.
* Experience deploying and managing GPU clusters without BCM is also valuable.
* Knowledge of InfiniBand, RDMA, and high-speed networking is an advantage.
* Exposure to multi-GPU or multi-node deployments is desirable.

DevOps, Containers, and Automation

* Hands-on experience with Docker and GPU-enabled containers.
* Kubernetes experience for GPU workload orchestration.
* Scripting and automation using Bash, Python, Ansible, Terraform, or equivalent tools.
* Familiarity with Git, CI/CD pipelines, configuration management, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
* Experience with Prometheus, Grafana, NVIDIA SMI, or DCGM for monitoring and observability.

LLM Deployment and Performance Optimization

* Experience deploying LLM applications on GPU-enabled cloud instances or on-premises GPU servers.
* Familiarity with vLLM, Ollama, Hugging Face TGI, NVIDIA Triton, or equivalent model-serving frameworks.
* Understanding of API-based model serving, GPU resource allocation, and VRAM management.
* Ability to troubleshoot model loading failures, CUDA errors, out-of-memory issues, and inference performance problems.
* Experience optimizing GPU utilization, inference latency, and throughput is desirable.

Experience Requirements

* Minimum 3 years of overall experience in DevOps, SRE, Platform Engineering, or Infrastructure Engineering.
* At least 1–2 years of hands-on experience working with GPU environments.
* Demonstrated involvement in at least one real-world GPU infrastructure setup, GPU cluster deployment, or AI/LLM infrastructure project.
* Ability to explain the GPU hardware, infrastructure architecture, individual responsibilities, deployment steps, and technical issues resolved.
* Production infrastructure support experience is preferred.

Preferred Qualifications

* End-to-end GPU cluster deployment using NVIDIA Base Command Manager.
* Hands-on experience with InfiniBand configuration and troubleshooting.
* Bare-metal GPU server installation and configuration.
* Multi-GPU and multi-node cluster deployment.
* Production LLM serving and GPU performance optimization.
* Experience supporting on-premises, cloud, and hybrid infrastructure environments.
* Experience supporting AI/ML or HPC workloads in production.

Technical Screening Requirements

Candidates should be prepared to discuss the following during the technical interview:

* Describe a real GPU infrastructure or on-premises AI infrastructure project.
* Identify the GPU hardware used, such as NVIDIA A100, H100, H200, L40S, RTX, or equivalent.
* Explain individual responsibilities in GPU setup, cluster configuration, NVIDIA driver installation, CUDA configuration, or LLM deployment.
* Describe a technical issue encountered during deployment and explain the troubleshooting steps taken to resolve it.
* Explain practical experience with Linux, Docker, Kubernetes, NVIDIA BCM, InfiniBand, or GPU monitoring tools.
* Describe an LLM deployment or GPU workload configured, including the environment, tools, and validation process, where applicable.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should be capable of independently configuring GPU environments, troubleshooting infrastructure and workload issues, automating deployment processes, and supporting reliable AI/ML and HPC operations.

Candidates with strong hands-on experience in GPU server setup, cluster bring-up, NVIDIA drivers, CUDA, and production AI infrastructure will be given preference.

Candidates with only theoretical knowledge of GPUs or general DevOps experience without practical GPU infrastructure exposure will not be suitable for this position.

How to Apply

Interested candidates can share their updated resumes with details of their GPU infrastructure experience, GPU hardware exposure, and relevant AI/LLM deployment projects.

**Deloitte Consulting LLP**

Join a collaborative team building and running production-grade web applications that deliver real business impact. You'll apply modern AI tooling to accelerate delivery, shape infrastructure plans from the ground up, and scope and size effort estimates for prospective client engagements — all while mentoring junior engineers and partnering with global teams. This role is based out of Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Kolkata, Chennai, or Pune.

* Design, plan, and architect end-to-end cloud infrastructure on AWS — VPC topology, IAM strategy, service networking, multi-account structure, and cost governance
* Own Kubernetes cluster operations across environments: provisioning, upgrades, RBAC hardening, network policies, autoscaling, and node lifecycle management

**Delivery Pipelines & Automation**

* Build and maintain GitOps delivery pipelines with ArgoCD — ensuring every deployment is auditable, rollback-ready, and environment-aware
* Author reusable, modular infrastructure as code with Terraform and Terragrunt, including safe remote state management and workspace patterns
* Design and maintain CI/CD workflows in GitHub Actions — multi-stage pipelines, build matrix strategies, environment promotion gates, and secret injection via Doppler

* Integrate SonarQube into the delivery pipeline to surface vulnerabilities and enforce quality gates before code ships
* Integrate with security vulnerability detection tools to enable quality validations

* Stand up and own DataDog observability end-to-end: dashboards, APM traces, log pipelines, synthetic checks, and SLO tracking tied to real service agreements
* Establish security-first infrastructure practices — threat modelling, least-privilege access, compliance controls, and structured incident response runbooks

* Partner with engineering teams to define platform standards, golden-path tooling, and self-service infrastructure patterns that reduce toil
* Actively use and promote advanced AI tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor AI, ChatGPT plugins) to improve development productivity
* Mentor team members and contribute to a collaborative, innovation-driven engineering culture

Reports to a Senior Consultant or Manager within IDT's platform engineering / DevOps practice. Partners with global engineering teams on platform standards and self-service tooling, and mentors junior engineers.

**Required**

* Deep, hands-on AWS expertise — EKS, IAM, VPC, RDS, S3, CloudFront, and the services that surround them
* Strong Kubernetes command: has built clusters, debugged scheduling failures, and hardened them for real workloads
* Production experience with a GitOps toolchain; ArgoCD experience strongly preferred
* Terraform at scale — modules, remote state, workspace strategy, and team-safe workflows; Terragrunt a clear advantage
* GitHub Actions pipeline authoring — knows how to keep pipelines fast, secure, and easy for others to maintain
* Docker fluency from base-image selection through multi-stage build optimization and vulnerability scanning
* Hands-on DataDog experience building observability from the ground up, not just reading pre-built dashboards
* Security-first mindset evidenced in day-to-day approach to secrets, credentials, access control, and dependency hygiene
* Clear, precise written communication — architecture decisions, runbooks, and post-mortems worth sharing with the team
* Excellent problem-solving, communication, and team collaboration skills
* Bachelor's degree (minimum three-year program) in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field

**Preferred**

* AWS is the required cloud platform; Azure or GCP experience is a plus

**Core Competencies**

* Security-first mindset across secrets, access, and dependency management
* Deep platform and infrastructure ownership from design through operations
* Clear, precise technical communication and documentation
* Strong problem-solving and cross-team collaboration
* Mentoring and contribution to a collaborative engineering culture
* Fluency with modern AI-assisted development tooling

**Why This Role Matters**

Reliable, secure, well-observed infrastructure is what lets every other team ship with confidence. This role owns that platform foundation end-to-end — from AWS and Kubernetes architecture through delivery pipelines, observability, and security — while mentoring the next generation of engineers and helping IDT build the hybrid businesses and enterprise platforms that future-proof Deloitte and its clients.

Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.

**Professional development**

  
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India.

At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization.
